card1.sousTitre: Comprehensive digital management platform for an independent restaurant.

description.intro: La Casa Altea is a full-stack platform developed with React, NestJS, Prisma, SQL, and TypeScript. It provides the restaurant with secure, autonomous, and efficient management of its operations.

fonctionnalites.f2: Advanced security: Token Guard, CORS, protection against cyberattacks.
fonctionnalites.f3: Admin dashboard to manage menus, availability, and orders.
fonctionnalites.f4: Automated email sending: confirmations, reminders, notifications.
fonctionnalites.f5: SEO & Performance optimization for better visibility.

description.atoutsTitre: Why is it a strong asset for the restaurant?

atouts.a1: Total autonomy: no need for intermediaries.
atouts.a2: Cost savings: reduced commissions from third-party platforms.
atouts.a3: Better control: real-time access to strategic data.

description.conclusion: Thanks to this platform, La Casa Altea now has a powerful tool to run its business with peace of mind, deliver an optimal customer experience, and maximize profitability.

card2.sousTitre: Interactive platform for ecological awareness and sustainable engagement.

description.intro: Earthway is a web application currently in development, designed as a platform to raise awareness about protecting the planet. Created at the request of an environmentally committed client, it revolves around four pillars: reforestation, coral preservation, pollinator protection, and the promotion of eco-friendly innovations.

fonctionnalites.f1: Subscription system with several engagement levels to support concrete environmental actions.
fonctionnalites.f2: Thematic news feed: dedicated to reforestation, oceans, pollinators, and green innovations.
fonctionnalites.f3: Ethical marketplace: sustainable products with affiliate links to eco-conscious partners.
fonctionnalites.f4: Community chat (coming in V2): a space for exchange between engaged members.

objectifs.o2: Involve users in concrete actions at their level.
objectifs.o3: Facilitate access to eco-friendly alternatives with a curated selection of products and services.
objectifs.o4: Build loyalty among a community with shared values and progressive commitment.

description.conclusion: Currently in the design phase, the interface is being prototyped in Adobe XD. This freelance full-stack project has an ambitious vision: to offer citizens a concrete space to take action for the planet.

card3.sousTitre: Interactive portfolio site for an artist specialized in tufting.

description.intro: Tuftissimo is a responsive portfolio site designed for a freelance artist specializing in tufting. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, it showcases her textile creations and facilitates client contact.

fonctionnalites.f1: Dynamic gallery of her rugs, mirrors, and tufted wall art.
fonctionnalites.f2: Direct link to Instagram to view the latest creations and place orders.
fonctionnalites.f3: Integrated messaging system for personalized requests.
fonctionnalites.f4: Polished front-end with subtle animations and textile texture highlights.
fonctionnalites.f5: Responsive design: smooth navigation on both mobile and desktop.
fonctionnalites.f6: Styled contact form with validation and user feedback.

description.atoutsTitre: Why is it a strong asset for Tuftissimo?

atouts.a1: Strong identity: showcases her unique artistic universe.
atouts.a2: Increased visibility: improved natural SEO with a dedicated site.
atouts.a3: Accessibility: her work is available online anytime.
atouts.a4: Direct connection: simplifies communication with clients.

description.conclusion: Tuftissimo allows the artist to present her work professionally while maintaining a human and creative connection with her clients. 🌟

card4.sousTitre: Redesign of a banking portal in the context of a merger.

description.intro: As a full-stack developer at Société Générale, I took part in several internal projects, playing a key role in redesigning a customer portal during the merger with Crédit du Nord.

responsabilites.r1: Front-end rebuild of the merged SG x Crédit du Nord site.
responsabilites.r2: Integration of video APIs for remote customer relations.
responsabilites.r3: Automated testing (unit, integration) with coverage tracking.
responsabilites.r4: Analytics tracking for monitoring user journeys.
responsabilites.r5: Performance testing to ensure smooth navigation.
responsabilites.r6: Accessibility improvements to meet RGAA standards.
responsabilites.r7: Application maintenance and daily technical support.

description.conclusion: This position allowed me to work in an agile team, within a demanding banking environment, complying with high quality and security standards, while contributing to high-visibility solutions. 🏦

card5.sousTitre: Advanced Chrome extension to enhance Okta via REST API.

description.intro: As a full-stack developer, I contributed to the development of Rockstar, a Chrome extension that enhances the Okta user experience with advanced features such as user CSV export and other useful tools for administrators.

fonctionnalites.f1: Real-time feature additions on the Okta interface.
fonctionnalites.f2: CSV export of users, groups, and custom settings.
fonctionnalites.f3: Automated and secure Okta REST API requests.
fonctionnalites.f4: Full-stack development with business logic in both the extension and Node backend.

missions.m1: Developing new features based on user feedback.
missions.m2: Bug fixing and managing technical tickets.
missions.m3: Writing unit tests and automated test scenarios.
missions.m4: Advanced Git usage for versioning and code reviews.
missions.m5: Constant communication with product teams (lots of Huddles).

description.conclusion: This experience allowed me to master the full software development lifecycle, with strong exposure to REST APIs, collaborative work, and automating repetitive tasks. 💼
